signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Define and own the product strategy for Orb's core billing platform
Lead product discovery: talk constantly with customers on the bleeding edge of pricing experimentation, learn how they think about pricing design and change, and translate that…
Shape the strategic questions that define the domain: what the right pricing abstractions are as customers grow from startup to enterprise, how price changes roll out safely…
Build strong partnerships with engineering and design, bringing them into discovery early so user and business implications surface before the plan is set
Lay the groundwork for product practices and processes so the team can define and deliver its highest-impact work as it grows

roles.title: Lead Product Manager, Entitlements & Spend Platform

bullets: Define and own the product strategy for entitlements, spend controls, alerting, and usage analytics — turning a fast-converging, ambiguous space into a clear plan with the right…
Lead product discovery: talk to customers constantly, learn how they actually govern spend and access, and translate that into what the team builds
Identify the smallest possible unit of value for the team to ship, and drive it through discovery, in-flight work, and launch
Shape the strategic questions that define the domain — how far entitlements stand on their own, where real-time enforcement matters most, what customers will build their most…
Build strong partnerships with engineering and design, bringing them into discovery early so user and business implications surface before the plan is set
